verified: Embo announced its public launch and a $110 million seed round led by a16z, according to the company's own announcement.
unconfirmed: The technical claims — that video-trained world models can generalize across robot bodies and acquire fine-grained motor skills in simulation — rest only on Embo's description; no model release, benchmark, demo video, customer deployment, valuation, full investor list or launch date has been disclosed.

verified: Embo 宣布完成 1.1 亿美元种子轮融资，由 a16z 领投，公司同时结束隐身状态；The Decoder 与 Embo 官方发布页均给出这一金额和领投方，并称团队成员来自 Google DeepMind、Meta 和 MIT。
unconfirmed: 技术路线本身——即“从互联网视频学习物理规律、在仿真中训练动作技能”能否支撑一个通用机器人大脑；报道未给出任何模型规模、演示视频、基准测试或第三方评测，也未披露估值、资金具体用途和产品时间表。

titles.en: Embo raises $110M seed led by a16z for world-model robot AI
titles.zh: Embo 获 1.1 亿美元种子轮，研发机器人世界模型
